title: A facile fabrication method of sericin/chitosan film without additives for fruit coating

In this study, we developed an additive-free film composed of SS and chitosan (CS) in ethanol environment, achieving enhanced tensile strength, elongation at break, and water retention and release capacity through structural modification of SS.
